goal: Versioned apprentice notebook with reviewed evolution and useful maintenance work
qualification: Mechanical pass/clean completion are not semantic acceptance. Both status originals and the preparation guide required factual corrections; notebook advice also required review. This is ordinary apprentice development, not a frozen reliability estimate.

landings.change: Explicit opt-in frozen notebook selection, normal reviewed revisions,85mechanism tests
Concise current status and exact historical archive; outer factual repairs
Inspector order/Unicode tests and first reviewed lesson
Real consumer identity and physically minimal dependency-tree checks
Shared progress limits, preserved behavior, narrowed notebook advice
Outer follow-up makes optional surrogate-pair case exercise an actual escaped pair
Preparation guide with factual corrections; chronology note accepted unchanged

comparisons.finding: Both originals pass mechanical archive/shape checks but fail current-state semantics. Fixed selected only after repairs; no observed quality advantage.
Both originals pass requirements and independent negative controls. Fixed selected for simpler child test, not timing. Similar times; no persuasive notebook benefit.

comparison_limits: One ordered matched seed per task; no causal speed/reliability estimate. Different note versions across tasks, fixed within each pair.
All initial repository preloads were excluded for max_bytes; no on/off preload-inclusion branch difference. Explicit notebook tool consultation was observed, including bash cat for inspector.
Task ceilings, briefing and dependency curation can dominate outcomes; strong task instructions make some notes redundant.
Evolving trials and accepted corrections are nonstationary qualitative evidence, not a pooled experimental arm.
lessons: Notebook exposure, proposals, outer corrections and later reuse all work without granting new authority.
Inspector proposed an overly specific receiver/fixture lesson; outer review generalized it.
Bounds proposed that object identity proves one definition; outer review corrected this false generalization for immutable values.
Guide retained an accurate chronology lesson after explicit outer feedback. This is assisted learning, not spontaneous rediscovery or evidence of future transfer.
The notebook did not prevent stale current-state claims. Advice can itself be plausible but wrong, so no automatic adoption is justified.
adoption: Keep explicit opt-in for apprentice work, omission for clean experiments, and ordinary substantive review before advice carries forward. No automatic memory system, AGENTS alias, permission change or general performance claim.

security.finding: No notebook-specific isolation blocker found by independent code review and live CPU containment probes. Not a proof of adversarial robustness.
limits: Concurrent uncooperative host writer race remains documented.
Read-only means final accepted export policy, not immutable solver filesystem.
Hashes and scope checks cannot establish advice quality, reviewer independence or adversarial evaluator correctness.

effort.method: Coarse active estimates in per-task review/preparation receipts; interleaved work and outer scaffolding repairs prevent precise labor or economic comparison.
effort.finding: Preparation and semantic review remain material; useful outputs do not establish apprentice cost competitiveness.

next_work_not_authorized: Use the notebook on future ordinary apprentice tasks and prune stale or over-specific guidance through normal review.
Evaluate transfer of the chronology lesson on a fresh task if that becomes useful; do not infer it from this goal.
